title: Baker Mayfield on Vita Vea: I hope they take care of him, he deserves it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield on Vita Vea: I hope they take care of him, he deserves it
sources.description: Baker Mayfield has some clear problems with the way the Buccaneers handled negotiating a potential contract extension this offseason, saying he feels "disrespected" and "undervalued" during his Thursday press conference.
